index = 0
validRepresentation = True

    if digits[index] == base:
        digits[index] = 0
        if index + 1 < len(digits):
            digits[index + 1] += 1
        else:
            digits.append(1)
    if digits[index] > 1:
        if digits[index] == base - 1:

            else:
                digits.append(1)
        else:
            validRepresentation = False
            break
    tempNumber //= base
    index += 1

print("YES" if validRepresentation else "NO")
